editorial.blurb: This vibrant all-you-can-eat Japanese spot wins diners over with stellar service, fresh fish, and standout cooked dishes that punch above the typical AYCE formula.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the teriyaki beef multiple times—reviewers couldn't stop reordering it—and skip the wings and takoyaki, which fall flat; stick to the miso eggplant, ramen, and sashimi that consistently impress.
